Counsel for Applicant :- Mr Arvind Kumar,Anand Mohan Pandey,Rahul Kumar Sharma,Rishabh A Counsel for Opposite Party :- A.G.A.,Adesh Kumar Dixit,Rahul Kumar Sharma Hon'ble Mrs. Sadhna Rani (Thakur),J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 and perused the record.

By moving this application the prayer is made to quash the entire proceeding of Case No. 4963 of 2016, Case Crime No. 25 of 2016 under Sections 498A, 323, 313, 354, 504, 506, 376 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Hathras.

As per facts of the case, by moving an application to Superintendent of Police concerned an FIR was lodged on 28.04.2016 by the opposite party no. 2 against the applicants with the allegations that her marriage was solemnized with Rashid Anwar as per muslim rituals on 10.04.2013, wherein about Rs. 15 lacs were spent and as per demand of in-laws of the opposite party no. 2, EON Hyundai car was also given, apart from 80 gms. gold jewellery, 350 gms. of silver jewellery and Rs. 51,000/- cash and other house hold items.

When the opposite party no. 2 reached at her matrimonial house, from the very next day she had to face taunts and allegations of her husband Rashid Anwar,
mother-in-law Seema Begum, brother-in-laws Shahid Anwar & Khalid Anwar, sister-in-laws (nanad) Guriya & Saima and sister-in-law (jethani) Shabnam w/o Shahid Husain that the dowry was not up to their expectations.

She tried to explain her in-laws the inability of her father to pay this additional dowry but her mother-in-law shouted at her and her husband snatched her hair and made her fall on the floor and rest accused persons thrashed her with kicks and blows.

She was kept without food and when she conceived, hearing this news all the in-laws flared up, thrashed her with kicks and blows at her stomach, which resulted into bleeding and when she reached in a position to die, her in-laws took her to the doctor and without her consent got aborted her pregnancy.
When she narrated this news to her parents, her father and brother came and tried to explain the situation but her in-laws did not pay any heed.
To save life of his daughter, her father paid Rs. 1,00,000/- to her husband and the in-laws.
Even then, the harassment of the in-laws did not come to an end.
The brother-in-law Khalid Anwar started having evil eye on her.
Whenever he found her alone he used to made obscene gesture and used to molest her.

On complaint to her in-law, she was again thrashed, this increased the courage of her brother-in-law Khalid Anwar, who started saying that if she makes him happy nobody would demand any additional dowry from her.

When she disclosed this fact again to her in-laws, she was again beaten, locked in a room and in the morning of 03.09.2015 they took her in a Qualis car to Hathras Bambe Agra Road and about 10 a.m., pushed her from the car and there also

,
she was abused and thrashed.

On hearing her hue and cry, the passerby Hemant Kumar, Haider,
Nisar and other persons came and saved her.
When she went to the police station the report was not lodged and since then, she is running from pillar to post for justice.

It is argued by the learned counsel for the applicants that in the entire FIR there is no allegation against rest applicants except husband (Rashid Anwar) and brother-in-law (Khalid Anwar) of the opposite party no. 2.
Both of them have appeared before the trial court.
Because of this false FIR the entire family is suffering.
The case is pending in District Hathras, while both the sister-in-laws (nanad) are living in Etah.
Their transfer application to transfer this case is pending before this court.

The incident is dated 03.09.2015 and the FIR has been lodged on 28.04.2016 and for the first time on 28.04.2016 in the statement of the alleged victim under Section 161 Cr.P.C. the allegation of rape against Khalid Anwar has come.
There is no document to prove the allegation of the offence under Section 313 Cr.P.C. against the applicants.
Hence, prayer is made to quash the entire proceeding of the aforesaid case.
Learned A.G.A. filed the counter affidavit but neither the counter affidavit on behalf of the opposite party no. 2 has been filed nor the rejoinder affidavit has been filed by the applicants.
It is argued by the learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 that in the statement under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. of the victim, the allegations of the FIR have been supported.
The revision against the cognizance order dated 08.12.2016 filed by the applicants was rejected by the trial court.
Further, it is argued that the cognizance order passed by the trial court is a lawful order passed on the basis of evidence on record.
Hence, prayer is made to reject the application.

From perusal of the FIR, it is found that the last incident is shown to be dated 03.09.2015, while the FIR has been lodged on the basis of application moved to the Superintendent of Police concerned on 28.04.2016.
There is general allegation of demand of dowry, harassment, causing abortion against all the applicants, allegations of rape and molesting the victim is against the brother-in-law Khalid Anwar only.

If the FIR is seen, the specific allegations can be said to be against the husband,

sentences.text: Not even a single specific allegation is there against both the sisters-in-law (nanad) Saima and Gudiya and sister-in-law (jethani) Shabnam w/o Shahid Anwar.
Though, there is specific allegation of the first informant against brother-in-law Khalid Anwar but against Shahid Anwar, there is no such allegation.

If we go through the statement of witnesses as mentioned in the FIR, witness Nisar has stated in his statement that on 03.09.2015 when he was going on Agra Road Hathras Bamba in front of Vikas Road park along with Majda 3-4 persons were standing thereby.
On being asked, Majda replied that those were her in-laws.
He has further stated that he recognises the husband of Majda and along with him 2-3 more persons were there, whom he could not recognise.
They all went leaving Majda there, then he himself accompanied Majda to go to her home.
Witness Haidar also stated in his statement that infront of Vikas park he saw some persons standing there and as soon as he reached there, those persons went away sitting in the car.
Thus, the allegation against all the seven persons involving them for the offence under Sections 498A, 323, 313, 354, 504, 506, 376 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, cannot be said to be proper.
The incident is dated 03.09.2015, while the FIR has been lodged after more than seven months of the incident by moving an application before the Superintendent of Police concerned on 27.04.2016.
The whole family of the husband of opposite party no. 2 has been implicated without assigning any specific role to most of the named persons.

On the basis of FIR, statement of the victim under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. and the statement of the witnesses; Nisar and Haidar, the maximum prima-facie offence under Sections 498A, 323, 313,
504, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act can be said to be made out against Rashid Anwar, Khalid Anwar and Seema Begum and the offence under Sections 354 and 376 IPC along with above mentioned sections can be said to be prima facie made out against Khalid Anwar only.

Hence, the entire proceeding of the Case No. 4963 of 2016 above are quashed against Shahid Anwar,
Guriya, Saima and Shabnam only.
Against rest of the applicants, the prayer of the applicant's counsel is rejected.
The application is allowed partly.
